snippet.title: Ghost of Yōtei - "Song of Vengeance" Trailer | PS5 Games
snippet.description:
https://www.playstation.com/games/ghost-of-yotei/ 

Available on PS5® October 2, 2025. 
Pre-order Now or Learn More: https://www.playstation.com/games/ghost-of-yotei/ 

Journey with Atsu in this unique story of healing and redemption that runs deeper than vengeance. Traverse the vast lands of Ezo, master new weapons, and forge alliances to avenge the death of her family at the hands of the Yōtei Six.

#ps5 #ps5games #gamescom 

Rated Mature
